equipment_type: Air-cooled magnetic-bearing centrifugal chiller (via SC-EQ card)
applies_to: YORK YVAM air-cooled magnetic-bearing centrifugal chillers fitted with the SC-EQ communication card.
summary: The YVAM's SC-EQ card puts the chiller on a BACnet MS/TP trunk (it also speaks Modbus RTU and N2). The BAS can run/stop the chiller and write the leaving chilled liquid setpoint and input current limit. Read-only points cover chilled liquid and ambient temperatures, refrigerant pressures, compressor VSD values and harmonics, magnetic bearing (MBC) status, condenser fan VSD speeds and faults, and operation, fault, warning and inhibit codes as MV objects with AV copies.
notes: Access is inferred: the sheet has no read/write column. The remote block (AV 1-2, BV 1) is treated as commandable and MV 65001 as writable; everything else as read-only.

Status-code MVs (MV 1-4, MV 6-8) are the printed code + 1, as the doc's status code tables say; the AV copies (AV 401-408) carry the raw code. MV 5 and MV 65001 are shown as printed, from 0; the card may report the printed number + 1. Confirm by discovery.
Input kWh and operating hours are also split into low/offset AVs (AV 121-124): total = offset x 10,000 + low.
Units shown are the IP units; with MV 65001 set to SI the card reports °C, kPa and so on.
Spare objects and empty rows are left out.

integration.summary: Wire the BAS to the SC-EQ J12 RS-485 port and set the MAC address; the card detects BACnet MS/TP. Run/stop the chiller with BV 1 and write the leaving chilled liquid setpoint (AV 1) and input current limit (AV 2). Read MV 1, BV 5, the leaving water temperature and % FLA, and MV 2/MV 3 for shutdowns. MV 5 shows whether the chiller is under ISN (BAS) control.

minimum_points.name: UNIT CONTROL SOURCE
minimum_points.why: Control source; ISN (BAS) for BMS control

integration.enable: BV 1 REM RUN STOP CMD (0 = Stop, 1 = Run) is the BAS run/stop and AV 1-2 the remote setpoints. MV 5 shows the control source (Local, ISN (BAS), Analog, Digital, Modem, Remote); it should read ISN for BAS control. The points list has no write-enable point.
setup: The BAS connects to the SC-EQ J12 port (RS-485: +, -, COM/REF, SHLD). The card detects BACnet MS/TP, Modbus RTU or N2 and the baud rate by itself; allow up to 120 seconds after power-up.
The MAC address (1-127) is set on DIP switch SW1 (switch 8 unused). Cycle the card's power after changing it.

The device instance defaults to 5000 + the MAC address (MAC 6 gives 5006). To use another number, set Device Instance Mode to Manual and enter the instance with the SC-AP / MAP tool, or write BV 65000 (mode) and AV 65000 (instance ID).
MV 65001 Units sets whether the BAS sees IP or SI values, independent of the chiller display; set it to match the chiller.
gotchas: The remote (commandable) setpoints read as unreliable until the BAS writes them the first time.
The SC-EQ only exposes the points that apply to the chiller it detects; if it replaces an E-Link, re-discover the device so old non-applicable points don't sit offline.
Code points come in pairs: the MV state is the code + 1, and the AV copy (AV 401-408) carries the raw code.
